mentions.name: Trackid
mentions.description: A tool that automatically syncs work-in-progress music from a digital audio workstation (DAW) to the user's phone, serving as a workflow tool for musicians and producers. It includes quick share and feedback functionality and integrates with Ableton, Bitwig, Cubase, and GarageBand.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a tool to automatically sync your work-in-progress music from your DAW (digital audio workstation, like Ableton Live, etc), to your phone. Basically a workflow tool for musicians and producers! Also has some quick share/feedback functionality too.
mentions.author: ultrasandwich
